<?php
if (!defined('ABSPATH')) { exit; }
add_filter('show_admin_bar', '__return_false');
add_action('after_setup_theme', function () {
  add_theme_support('title-tag');
  add_theme_support('html5', ['style', 'script']);
});
add_action('wp_enqueue_scripts', function () {
  $theme = get_template_directory_uri();
  $brand = get_post_meta(get_queried_object_id(), '_demo_brand', true);
  $style = $brand === 'tideland' ? 'tideland.css' : 'studio.css';
  $script = $brand === 'tideland' ? 'tideland.js' : 'studio.js';
  wp_enqueue_style('musedesk-demo-style', $theme . '/' . $style, [], '1.0.0');
  wp_enqueue_script('musedesk-demo-script', $theme . '/' . $script, [], '1.0.0', true);
});

<!doctype html>
<html <?php language_attributes(); ?>>
<head>
<meta charset="<?php bloginfo('charset'); ?>">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<?php wp_head(); ?>
</head>
<?php
$post_id = get_queried_object_id();
$body_class = get_post_meta($post_id, '_demo_body_class', true);
$page_key = get_post_meta($post_id, '_demo_page_key', true);
$body_attrs = get_post_meta($post_id, '_demo_body_attrs', true);
?>
<body <?php body_class($body_class); ?> <?php echo $body_attrs; ?> data-demo-page="<?php echo esc_attr($page_key); ?>">
<?php wp_body_open(); ?>
<?php echo get_post_meta($post_id, '_demo_header_html', true); ?>

<?php get_header(); ?>
<?php while (have_posts()) : the_post(); the_content(); endwhile; ?>
<?php get_footer(); ?>

<?php get_footer(); ?>

<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$demo_admin = get_user_by('login', 'admin');
if (!$demo_admin) throw new Exception('Missing Playground demo administrator.');
wp_set_current_user($demo_admin->ID);
kses_init();
$posts = json_decode(base64_decode(''), true);
$ids = [];
update_option('permalink_structure', '/%postname%/');
flush_rewrite_rules();
foreach ($posts as $post) {
  $content = '<!-- wp:html -->' . $post['content'] . '<!-- /wp:html -->';
  $id = wp_insert_post(wp_slash([

    'post_title' => $post['title'],
    'post_name' => $post['slug'],
    'post_status' => 'publish',
    'post_type' => 'page',
    'post_content' => $content,
    'meta_input' => [
      '_demo_brand' => $post['brand'],
      '_demo_page_key' => $post['pageKey'],
      '_demo_body_class' => $post['bodyClass'],
      '_demo_body_attrs' => $post['bodyAttrs'],
      '_demo_header_html' => $post['header'],
      '_demo_footer_html' => $post['footer'],
    ],
  ]), true);
  if (is_wp_error($id)) throw new Exception($id->get_error_message());
  $ids[$post['slug']] = $id;
}
foreach ($ids as $slug => $id) {
  $page = get_post($id);
  $content = str_replace('__THEME_ASSET_URL__', get_template_directory_uri(), $page->post_content);
  foreach ($ids as $target_slug => $target_id) { $content = str_replace('__WP_URL_' . $target_slug . '__', get_permalink($target_id), $content); }
  wp_update_post(['ID' => $id, 'post_content' => wp_slash($content)]);
  foreach (['_demo_header_html', '_demo_footer_html'] as $meta) {
    $html = get_post_meta($id, $meta, true);
    $html = str_replace('__THEME_ASSET_URL__', get_template_directory_uri(), $html);
    foreach ($ids as $target_slug => $target_id) { $html = str_replace('__WP_URL_' . $target_slug . '__', get_permalink($target_id), $html); }
    update_post_meta($id, $meta, wp_slash($html));
  }
}
update_option('show_on_front', 'page');
update_option('page_on_front', $ids['musedesk-demo-launcher']);
update_option('permalink_structure', '/%postname%/');
flush_rewrite_rules();
